Manuscript records
Compiled Chapter IV scope (continued)
12.6–12.10
The normalized logarithm on each zero-free disk has the convergent
zero-moment series. Its coefficients equal 𝜅𝑁,𝑚and satisfy Newton’s
recurrence. The Mittag–Leffler tangent expansion converges absolutely and
locally uniformly away from poles. Tangent coefficients and the named
reciprocal and theta families have their exact zero-moment Bell formulas. The
full tangent series is identified with the analytic function.
13.1–13.4
Analytic division constructs each simple-zero principal part. Its leading
coefficient is uniquely determined. Removing the principal parts gives a
holomorphic remainder and the exact factorial-scaled Cauchy estimate. Both
leading-term errors are bounded, with the first absent for 𝑟= 1. Rotation
gives the orbit-reduced main term. The secant formula holds as a ratio limit,
with an exponentially vanishing relative error.
14.2–14.4, 14.6
The exact all-zero sums retain analytic multiplicity. Their sharp
absolute-convergence domains, boundary divergence and local uniform
convergence are checked. Both Hurwitz comparisons, entire corrections,
global meromorphic continuations, unique simple poles and exact residues
are proved. The order-two/four models have identically zero corrections.
Branch choices on the finite exceptional part change the continuation by an
entire function and preserve its pole and residue.
14.8
The derivative-weighted series uses every actual simple zero and genuine
logarithms with bounded arguments. Absolute and local uniform
convergence and an entire sum are proved for 𝑁≥3. For 𝑁= 2,
absolute/local uniform convergence and holomorphy hold on ℜ𝑠> 1.
The declaration-level theorem map is authoritative for the formal contract. It records full scoped
coverage of all 68 theorem-like records: 68 full, zero partial, and zero unmapped. Rows 143–151 close
the final fifteen partial records without altering their statements or assumptions. Imported standard
fact 11.1 remains imported. Formal identities, normalized analytic germs, and fixed logarithm domain
identities retain their respective stated meanings. Finite computations do not change these proof
boundaries.
17 Conclusion
Cyclic projection turns the exponential into a finite differential basis, and the signed cycle produces the
distinguished denominator D𝑁. Its reciprocal powers yield Bell and Newton recurrences, an additive
parameter law, Appell systems, and theta polynomials. Reduction by 𝑤= 𝑧𝑁then connects the
reciprocal coefficients to a genus zero product and reduced-zero power sums.
Classical two term localization, specialized to the regular exponent polygon and combined with
reflection symmetry, places all sufficiently large zeros on symmetry rays. The displacement, derivative
and counting estimates yield the family-specific Hurwitz comparison for the orbit zero zeta.

The earlier revision made two further substantive corrections. In corollary 6.12, every irreducible
component is contained in the full support. The previous sentence reversed that containment. In
theorem 10.5, the coefficient, continuity, integrality, class finiteness, and quotient condition hypotheses
are now explicit. Finite forests by themselves establish branches, not all arithmetic effectivity assertions.
Corollary 3.2 now gives the closed kernel argument and the continuity and uniqueness of its factors.
The original manuscript and its literal claim records are preserved with the release. In that original
census, 41 claims are fully checked, seven are partial, and one is not checked as written. The corrected
corollary 6.12 and restricted theorem 10.5 are counted as proved only for their revised statements. The
original unrestricted completion wording is not retrospectively marked proved. Source hashes, the
exact amendments, compiler logs, and a mathematical self-review accompany the code.
Compiler and axiom checks are distinguished from semantic proof review and external arithmetic
results.
